name: pr-bar
description: A bar above the prompt with the current branch's GitHub PR, CI state and unread review comments, plus a /pr detail pane that hands failing checks and comments to Claude.

barLayout.title: Bar layout
barLayout.description: compact: one line (PR, CI, new comments). full: two rows with the title, failing check names, attachments and buttons.

showPassingChecks.title: List passing checks
showPassingChecks.description: List passing and skipped checks in the /pr pane instead of folding them into one line.

showConversation.title: Show conversation comments
showConversation.description: Show PR conversation comments and review summaries (bot reports, coverage, review overviews) in the /pr pane and the new-comment count. Inline review comments always show.

showResolved.title: Show resolved threads
showResolved.description: List the comments on resolved review threads in the /pr pane, dimmed and after the open ones, instead of folding them into one line. They never count as new.

openOnNewPr.title: Open the pane for a new PR
openOnNewPr.description: Open the /pr pane when a PR is opened for the current branch during the session (for example by gh pr create). Once per PR; the bar shows either way.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: Used only when GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN and `gh auth token` all come up empty.
